2173-4574-4779-7435--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.
2173-4574-4779-7435--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

856-3899-5631-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

586-864-2034-3125-5631.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2034-3125-5631.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Skeleton Crew.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

465-670-1619-6151.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
465-670-1619-6151.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Underdark Explorer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, it triggers, returning Underdark Explorer from exile to the battlefield.
When Underdark Explorer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Underdark Explorer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
Repeat from step 5.

2103-2556-7631.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-719-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Xenograft, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-719-2511.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

661-3685-4659-5645.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {2} due to Stenn. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

321-399-1976-2475-6707.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

104-3490-4050-5870.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4050-5870.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

4681-6797-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

1829-3054-3416-5670.easyPrerequisites:
You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
1829-3054-3416-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once, sacrificing the Vampire token instead.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is level 4 or higher

1318-2743-5362.description:
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by tapping it, copying Quantum Misalignment twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Quantum Misalignment spells, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

3122-4608-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Undercover Operative.
3122-4608-5466.notablePrerequisites: You control five or more enchantments.
3122-4608-5466.description:
Cast Undercover Operative by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Undercover Operative into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Undercover Operative's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Undercover Operative's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Undercover Operative's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

1870-3609-4153-4331.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 3 or higher.
1870-3609-4153-4331.description:
Cast Eternity Vessel by paying {6}. Eternity Vessel enters the battlefield with a number of charge counters on it equal to your life total.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving all charge counters from Eternity Vessel onto Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
If Magistrate's Scepter has few than three charge counters on it, activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Eternity Vessel from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 3 during your next turn if Magistrate's Scepter has three or more charge counters on it. Otherwise, repeat from step 1.
1870-3609-4153-4331.notes: The amount of mana you need to pay each turn varies based off your starting life total. You can also stagger the steps across turns, possibly, to save paying lots of mana in one turn. You could also copy Eternity Vessel using Drafna's first ability, if desired/able, and move the counters from the token onto Magistrate's Scepter.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

974-1235-4477.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a token copy of the Smaug token and Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Smaug token that died and the Greenwarden of Murasa token trigger.
Resolve the Smaug trigger, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

1308-2043-4050-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {2}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1339-2034-2122-3384.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability twice by paying {2} and discarding two cards, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

643-1429-2829-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
643-1429-2829-5402.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

222-527-1115-2921.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-1115-2921.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

654-1170-1418-4124-5954.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2061-2187-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons each turn.
2061-2187-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Possessed Skaab.
When the Possessed Skaab token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2060-2292-2744-3327.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
2060-2292-2744-3327.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

190-202-4250-4591.notablePrerequisites: Nova Cleric does not have summoning sickness.
190-202-4250-4591.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Lich and causing each opponent to create a token copy of Lich, and lose life equal to their life totals due to Lich's effect.
You cannot lose the game due to having 0 or less life due to Platinum Angel.
Activate Nova Cleric by paying {2}{W}, tapping and sacrificing it, destroying all enchantments.
Each opponent's Lich triggers, causing them to lose the game.

141-549-4483.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least once this game.
141-549-4483.description:
Cast Echo Storm by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting Naru Meha.
Echo Storm triggers, creating a copy of itself, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Echo Storm, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put the token Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Naru Meha token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a copy of Echo Storm, targeting Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.

1266-4050-4166-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Goblin Arsonist, adding {R}.
When Goblin Arsonist dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Arsonist on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Arsonist trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Ob Nixilis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself, and exiling Goblin Arsonist from the top of your library with the ability to play it until your end step.
Cast Goblin Arsonist from exile by paying {R}.
Repeat.

678-1872-2506.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
When Composite Golem dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Composite Golem to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Composite Golem by paying {6}.
When Composite Golem enters the battlefield, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a token copy of Composite Golem with haste.
Activate the Composite Golem token by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.

643-1789-2232-3558.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, Lathliss and Cloudstone Curio triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

871-1299-4050-4399-5222.description:
Cast Expedition Envoy by paying {W/P}.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Whenever Expedition Envoy enters the battlefield, it and Ondu Cleric trigger.
Resolve the Expedition Envoy trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ondu Cleric trigger, causing you to gain at least two life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Soldier token, adding {W}.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Expedition Envoy.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Expedition Envoy, adding {1}.
When Expedition Envoy dies, Sword of the Realms triggers, returning Expedition Envoy from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

120-3258.description:
Use {6} to activate Planar Portal to find Beacon of Tomorrows.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrow for {6} {U} {U} and have it shuffle into your library.
Pass to your next turn.

1518-1987-2493-4792.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1518-1987-2493-4792.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Archaeomancer, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.
